episodes.title: Escaping Rama (Part 3): Life After The Cult
episodes.description:
⚠️ Content advisory: This episode includes discussions of childhood abuse, neglect, physical and sexual abuse, religious manipulation, and trauma within a cult environment. Listener discretion is advised.

In Part 3 of our conversation, we continue exploring the lasting impact of growing up inside a cult and what it looks like to move forward after leaving.

Shifrah opens up about reconnecting with her biological siblings, navigating the complicated emotions and different perspectives that come with shared childhood trauma, and learning how to rebuild relationships while continuing her own healing. 

She also explains why speaking publicly about her experiences matters so much, especially for those who may still be questioning what they experienced or wondering if they're alone.

This is part 3 of our 4-part series.

Grab a coffee, pull up a chair, and get ready to hear more of Shifrah's experience.

Follow Shifrah on TikTok for more of her story: https://www.tiktok.com/@morganshifrah

episodes.title: Escaping Rama (Part 2): Kicked Out and Adopted
episodes.description:
Our conversation with Shifrah Morgan continues in Part 2. 

She shares how she found a new family, how the group cut people off, how the money worked, rebuilding things with her biological mother, and why her anger is aimed at the adults who could have spoken up.

This is part 2 of a 4-part series. Stay tuned for more.

episodes.title: Escaping Rama (Part 1): Born Into The Cult
episodes.description:
Shifrah Morgan joins us to discuss her experience with the Rama Cult. 

She describes what it was like to grow up inside: the punishments, the constant hypervigilance, and how the outside world treated cult kids. 

She also talks about the few kind people who showed up for her, the violence she witnessed and how it shaped her, the trauma responses she still works through, and the abuse that happened inside other members’ homes.

This is part 1 of a 4-part series. Stay tuned for more.

⚠️ Content advisory: This episode includes frank discussion of childhood abuse, physical violence, and cult control. Viewer discretion is advised. The accounts shared are Shifrah’s personal recollections and experiences.

Grab a coffee, pull up a chair, and prepare yourself for Shifrah's experience.
